findings.message: `test_install_refuses_broken_binary` calls `cli.main(["provider", "install", "claude"], cwd=Path("/repo"), ...)` without patching `Path.is_file`. `cli_status` then runs `Path("/repo/node_modules/.bin/claude").is_file()` against the real disk, outside `tmp_path`. This makes the unit test depend on the machine's filesystem. The existing `test_install` and `test_status` patch `Path.is_file` to avoid exactly this.
findings.paved_road: Add `monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "is_file", lambda self: False)` (or `True` for the project path) in `test_install_refuses_broken_binary` before calling `cli.main`, as `test_install` does.
